label: MKS PAMP acquires full ownership, DGLD relaunch
note: 2025-11-20: MKS PAMP acquired full ownership and relaunched DGLD; the relaunch is the material event for the active asset.

label: Ethereum-Base bridge exploit, phantom deposits mint unbacked DGLD on Base
note: 2026-02-23: a legacy Ethereum transferFrom that could report success without moving tokens let the bridge accept phantom deposits and mint unbacked DGLD on Base, including one 100M-token mint against roughly 70.8 legitimate Base tokens. Contracts were paused the same day; Base balances were reset to pre-exploit levels on March 11 and hardened contracts resumed by March 17. Issuer estimates about USD 250k economic impact, mostly company-borne, and states the gold was never at risk. The bridge was closed on June 30, 2026.
